title: Visualizing and Interpreting Temporal Care Team Dynamics for Cancer Survival Risk Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.30748v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cancer care is a longitudinal, time-sensitive process requiring coordination among diverse healthcare professionals (HCPs), whose collaboration evolves throughout treatment. Prior studies link care team structure to patient outcomes, but the temporal dynamics of collaboration and their relationship to evolving patient risk remain poorly understood. We introduce a visual analytics framework for modeling and interpreting time-varying care team interactions in oncology. We construct dynamic collaboration networks from electronic health record (EHR)-mediated communication data and use a temporal graph neural network (TGNN) to estimate patient outcome risk over time. We then investigate how changes in care team composition and specialist participation relate to shifts in estimated risk across treatment stages. translated_title: 可视化与解读肿瘤生存风险分析中的时间性护理团队动态
translated_abstract: 癌症护理是一个纵向的、时间敏感的过程，需要多种医疗专业人员（HCPs）之间的协调配合，其协作关系在整个治疗过程中不断演变。先前的研究已将护理团队结构与患者预后联系起来，但协作的时间动态及其与患者风险演变之间的关系仍知之甚少。我们提出了一个可视化分析框架，用于建模和解读肿瘤学中随时间变化的护理团队互动。我们基于电子健康记录（EHR）介导的通信数据构建动态协作网络，并使用时间图神经网络（TGNN）来估计患者随时间推移的预后风险。随后，我们研究护理团队组成和专科医生参与的变化如何与各治疗阶段估计风险的变动相关联。我们的多视图交互系统将基于TGNN的风险建模与护理团队网络的联动可视化相结合。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个可视化分析框架，通过EHR通信数据构建动态协作网络并结合时间图神经网络（TGNN），建模肿瘤护理团队随时间变化的互动，并揭示团队组成与专科参与的变化同患者风险演变之间的关系。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a visual analytics framework that constructs dynamic collaboration networks from EHR communication data and employs temporal graph neural networks (TGNN) to model time-varying cancer care team interactions and interpret how team dynamics relate to evolving patient survival risk.
